answer: Give every identity a non-transferable age credential that accrues only while it stays active: a newborn identity holds almost no voting or earning weight, like a lantern just lit, and influence grows as slowly as a glacier. An attacker can mint a garden of puppets in an afternoon, but each one must then be tended for months before it matters, paying upkeep the whole time. Limits: honest newcomers start weak, and a patient farmer can still age puppets, so age must combine with other checks.
